message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision in this Monopoly turn.

I have four orange properties and need Tennessee from p3. I am missing the green set. p1 owns two light blue, two pink, two railroads, Ventnor, and North Carolina.

p2 is in jail with $167 and a dangerous dark blue monopoly with two houses each. p3 owns Tennessee, which blocks my orange set, plus Baltic, Oriental, Illinois, and Short Line. Virginia, Atlantic, Marvin Gardens, and Pacific are still unowned.

The prior trade offer was rejected. I will end the turn rather than chase a worse deal. I will not give p2 cash or trade orange properties until the set is complete. Boardwalk with two houses costs $600, so my $845 should survive that hit.

A three-house Boardwalk would bankrupt me. p2 cannot afford to build another house on the dark blues. p1 could buy Pacific for $300 and complete a green set, but I still hold Pennsylvania.

I should buy yellows if I land on them. Virginia is unowned and would block p1's pink monopoly. I cannot build or unmortgage anything right now. Trading with p3 would only give away more cash or orange properties. p1 might be a better trade target since they want Oriental from p3 to complete their light blue set.
